desc:
📢 Official announcement from SOMETOWN OFFICIAL server

After continuous development and testing, SOMETOWN OFFICIAL has now officially launched 🎉

To thank all players for their support
Players who have favorited the game / enabled notifications / liked the game
You will receive a +20% increase in the rate of obtaining bonus items.

🎮 Controls Details (Key Bindings) - SOMETOWN

F1 = Mobile Phone
F2 = Bag / Luggage
F3 = Character Carrying Menu
F5 = Dance Menu
U = Lock/Unlock Car
R = Car Horn / Siren
TAB = Check Scoreboard
M = Map (You can place pins at various locations)
T = Chat via Voice Radio
Shift = Run
C = Slide

📱 Full mobile functionality support

Thank you to all players for being a part of SOMETOWN OFFICIAL
Have fun playing, and see you in the city! 🌆✨
